client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=200, system=SYSTEM,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What does error E101 mean?"}])
q: Where does the system prompt travel in the request body?
o: In its own field called system, next to messages
As the first message with the role system
why: In this API the system prompt is a separate field. Other providers use a message with the role system, so read your provider's page.

history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": first.content[0].text})
history.append({"role": "user", "content": "And what should I do about it?"})
o: The first question, the first answer and the new question
why: A call is stateless. The model remembers only what you send again.

q: A made-up key reaches the provider. What comes back?
why: This one comes from the provider as an HTTP 401, which the library turns into AuthenticationError.
max_tokens is required in this API: you always decide the limit of the answer.

c: print("stop reason:", message.stop_reason)   # the answer was cut at max_tokens=5
q: What would stop_reason say, and what does it mean?
o: max_tokens: the answer was cut off at your limit
why: end_turn means the model finished. max_tokens means it was cut off, and the text may be incomplete. (The output shown is the shape of a normal response.)
